description: Asks whether every problem whose answer can be checked in polynomial time can also be solved in polynomial time. A proof either way reshapes cryptography, optimization and AI search.
Claims every nontrivial zero of the Riemann zeta function lies on the line with real part one half. It controls the error term in the distribution of primes.
Asks whether smooth initial data for the 3D incompressible Navier-Stokes equations always gives a smooth solution for all time, or whether blow-up can occur.
Asks for a rigorous construction of 4D quantum Yang-Mills theory with a positive lower bound on the mass of its excitations.
Claims that on a projective complex manifold, certain cohomology classes are rational combinations of classes of algebraic subvarieties.
Links the rank of an elliptic curve's group of rational points to the order of vanishing of its L-function at s = 1.
Every simply connected closed 3-manifold is the 3-sphere. Perelman proved it in 2003 with Ricci flow with surgery.
No positive integers satisfy a^n + b^n = c^n for n above 2. Wiles proved it in 1994 through modularity of semistable elliptic curves.
Four colors suffice for any planar map. Proved by computer in 1976 and checked in Coq by Gonthier in 2005.
Face-centered cubic packing is the densest packing of equal spheres. Hales proved it in 1998, and the Flyspeck project checked the proof formally in 2014.
Claims infinitely many primes p have p + 2 also prime. Zhang, Maynard and Polymath bounded the gap at 246.
Claims every even integer above 2 is a sum of two primes. Verified to 4 x 10^18, and the weak ternary version was proved by Helfgott in 2013.
Claims that iterating n to n/2 or 3n+1 reaches 1 from every start. Tao showed almost all orbits attain almost bounded values.
Bounds c by the radical of abc for coprime a + b = c. Mochizuki's claimed proof is not accepted by most number theorists.
A web of conjectures matching Galois representations with automorphic forms, a grand unified theory for number theory.
The geometric form of Langlands, proved in 2024 by Gaitsgory, Raskin and collaborators across a series of papers near 1000 pages long.
Boolean sensitivity is polynomially related to block sensitivity. Huang proved it in 2019 with a two page argument on the hypercube.
Bounds the largest subset of F_3^n with no three-term progression. Ellenberg and Gijswijt proved an exponential bound in 2016 with the polynomial method.
Sets with small doubling in F_2^n are covered by few cosets of a subgroup. Gowers, Green, Manners and Tao proved it in 2023, formalized in Lean within three weeks.
Campos, Griffiths, Morris and Sahasrabudhe improved the 1935 upper bound of 4^k on diagonal Ramsey numbers by an exponential factor in 2023.
Asks for the fewest colors so no two points at unit distance share one. The answer lies between 5 and 7 after de Grey's 2018 graph.
BB(5) = 47,176,870, settled in 2024 by the bbchallenge collaboration with a Coq proof.
Asks whether graph isomorphism is in P. Babai gave a quasipolynomial algorithm in 2015.
Asks for the exponent omega of matrix multiplication. The bound sits near 2.371 and could be 2.
Khot's conjecture that approximating unique games is NP-hard. It would pin the exact approximation thresholds of many problems.
Asks whether quantum computers solve problems classical randomized machines cannot, in the unrelativized world.
Asks for the classical complexity of factoring integers. RSA rests on its hardness, and Shor's algorithm breaks it on a quantum machine.
Asks whether functions exist that are easy to compute and hard to invert on average. All private-key cryptography depends on them.
No algorithm decides whether an arbitrary program halts. Turing proved it by diagonalization in 1936.
No algorithm decides whether a Diophantine equation has integer solutions. Matiyasevich completed the proof in 1970.
The continuum hypothesis is independent of ZFC. Godel showed consistency in 1940 and Cohen showed independence by forcing in 1963.
Asks whether every bounded operator on a separable Hilbert space has a nontrivial closed invariant subspace.
Claims a polynomial map with constant nonzero Jacobian determinant has a polynomial inverse.
Claims a Hadamard matrix exists for every order divisible by 4. Order 668 is the smallest open case.
Predict 3D protein structure from sequence. AlphaFold 2 reached experimental accuracy in CASP14 in 2020.
Explain how and how fast a chain finds its native fold, the kinetic side left open by structure prediction.
Close the Reynolds-averaged equations from first principles, and derive Kolmogorov scaling and its intermittency corrections.
Find a consistent quantum theory of gravity that reduces to general relativity at low energy.
Identify the matter that shapes rotation curves, lensing and the CMB but emits no light.
Explain why the measured vacuum energy sits about 120 orders of magnitude below the field theory estimate.
The local distance ladder gives H0 near 73 km/s/Mpc while the CMB gives near 67. Systematics or new physics.
Claims generic gravitational collapse hides every singularity behind an event horizon.
Asks whether black hole evaporation destroys information. Island calculations reproduce a unitary Page curve.
Asks how definite outcomes and the Born rule arise from unitary quantum evolution.
Explain the pairing mechanism of high-temperature superconductors well enough to design one that works at room temperature.
Find the ground state phase diagram of the 2D Hubbard model, the minimal model for cuprates.
Quantum Monte Carlo for fermions suffers exponential cancellation. Troyer and Wiese showed a general fix is NP-hard.
Explain why liquids cooled past freezing stiffen into amorphous solids without a clear thermodynamic transition.
Explain water's density maximum, heat capacity and interface structure from its hydrogen bond network.
Predict the best catalyst for a reaction from first principles, past the limits of linear scaling relations.
Find the exact exchange-correlation functional that makes Kohn-Sham DFT exact. It exists by the Hohenberg-Kohn theorem.
Derive a chemical path from prebiotic molecules to self-replicating, evolving cells.
Explain how electron transport, redox state and membrane potential in mitochondria set the rate of aging.
Quantify how light timing and spectrum drive clock genes, melatonin and metabolism.
Explain how membrane voltage patterns store and control anatomical form during development and regeneration.
Decide whether aging is a program, accumulated damage or an entropy process, and which clock measures it.
Explain why physical processes give rise to subjective experience.
Explain how the brain combines features processed in separate areas into one percept.
Friston's claim that self-organizing systems minimize variational free energy. Formal status and falsifiability are debated.
Verify that a learned system pursues the objectives its designers intend, with guarantees.
Bound what fixed-depth transformers compute, with and without chain of thought, in circuit complexity terms.
Translate informal mathematics into Lean or other formal languages automatically and at scale.
Smale's 18th problem asks for the limits of intelligence, human and artificial.
Maymin argued weak-form market efficiency holds if and only if P = NP. The link between hardness and arbitrage stays open.
Computing a Nash equilibrium is PPAD-complete. Daskalakis, Goldberg and Papadimitriou proved it in 2006.
Myerson solved single-item revenue-optimal auctions in 1981. The multi-item case has no closed form.
Volatility is rough, with Hurst exponent near 0.1. Pricing and hedging under rough volatility lacks closed forms.
Asks whether the elliptic curve discrete log problem has a subexponential classical algorithm. Bitcoin and TLS rely on it.
Asks for the optimal proof size and verifier time for transparent succinct arguments.
Narrow equilibrium climate sensitivity, now 2.5 to 4 degrees per CO2 doubling, mostly through cloud feedback.
Predict and suppress plasma instabilities in magnetic confinement well enough for net energy gain.
